TextJPN: 「…あのさおじさん、ちょっと頼みがあるんだけど」
TextENG: ``...Hey, I have a favor to ask of you.``

TextJPN: 「ん？　なんだい魅音ちゃん、改まって」
TextENG: ``Hmm? What's up, Mion-chan, all of a sudden?``

TextJPN: 「これをさ、…ちょっと調達してもらいたいんだよね。@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3023.あ、代金はちゃんとバイト代から払うからさ」
TextENG: ``Okay, so, ...there's something I would like you to get for me.@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3023. Ah, of course I'll pay for it with what I earned from my part-time job.``
``What is it...@k@vS20/00/VTT_yoshiro3003. you want that one?!``

TextJPN: 私の指差したおもちゃカタログのページを見るや、善郎おじさんは思いっきり仰天した表情で私に振り返ってきた。
TextENG: When he looked at the page I was pointing to in the toy catalogue, Uncle Yoshirou turned back to me with an astounded expression.

TextJPN: 「これを手に入れて、いったい何に使う気なんだいっ？@k@vS20/00/VTT_yoshiro3005.　――まさか魅音ちゃん、あそこの郵便局に強盗をッ…？！」
TextENG: ``What on earth do you want to do with this if you get it?@k@vS20/00/VTT_yoshiro3005. ―You're not planning to rob the post office, are you...?!``

TextJPN: 「ちょ、ちょっとちょっと？@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3025.　私ゃそんなにお金にゃ困ってないってば！@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3026.　…それにちゃんと見てよ、ここ。@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3027.実弾どころか、プラスチック弾ですらないでしょうに」
TextENG: ``He- hey!@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3025. I'm not struggling for money that much!@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3026. ...Also, look closely, here.@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3027. It doesn't even fire plastic bullets, let alone real ones.``

TextJPN: 「え？　…あ、ほんとだ。@k@vS20/00/VTT_yoshiro3007.にしても魅音ちゃん、…少なくともこれって、女の子がほしがるものじゃないと思うんだけどなぁ」
TextENG: ``Eh? ...Ah, you're right.@k@vS20/00/VTT_yoshiro3007. But still, Mion-chan, ...at the very least, I feel like this isn't something a girl would normally want.``

TextJPN: 「えー、そうかなぁ？@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3029.　やっぱりハジキとドスは、カチコミの花ってやつでしょ～？@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3030.　あっはっはっはっ！」
TextENG: ``Oh, is that how it is?@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3029. But aren't guns and daggers what make gang raids really shine~?@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3030. Ahahaha!``

TextJPN: 「…茜さんにそう伝えておくよ」
TextENG: ``...I'll be telling Akane-san you said that.``

TextJPN: 「えっ？！　い、いや冗談だって、冗談っ！！@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3032.　あ、あはははは～」
TextENG: ``Eh?! I-it was a joke, only a joke!!@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3032. Ah, ahahaha~``

TextJPN: 冗談じゃない。あの人がこんな発言を聞いたら、問答無用で私は『地獄』を見せられるっての…！
TextENG: But this is no joke for me. If that person finds out I said this, I will undoubtedly encounter my personal hell.

TextJPN: 「とりあえず、問屋には問い合わせてみるけど。@k@vS20/00/VTT_yoshiro3010.輸入品の上に特注みたいだから、いつ手に入るかまでは保証できないよ？」
TextENG: ``Well, I'll make an inquiry with the wholesaler for the time being.@k@vS20/00/VTT_yoshiro3010. Since this would have to be specially ordered and imported, I can't make any guarantees for when it'll arrive, alright?``

TextJPN: 「う～ん、…それでも、なるべく早く頼むよ。@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3034.来るべき決戦の秘密兵器にするつもりだからさ」
TextENG: ``Su~re. ...But still, try to get it as fast as you can.@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3034. I want to use it as my secret weapon in the upcoming showdown.``

TextJPN: 「…だから、なんに使うつもりなの？」
TextENG: ``...Like I asked before, what are you planning to use it for?``

TextJPN: 「それは禁則事項だよ、おじさん。@k@vS20/03/VTT_mion3036.あっはっはっは～！」
